info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Unit Trust Administration Retrieval API
info.description: This API facilitates the retrieval of unit trust administration details, enabling clients to access specific information related to unit trusts quickly and efficiently. It serves as a vital resource for financial institutions, investment managers, and advisors who need to obtain comprehensive data regarding unit trust operations. Typical use cases include monitoring market performance and managing investor relations. By utilizing this endpoint, users can seamlessly integrate unit trust information into their applications for enhanced decision-making and client service.
